about_the_game:
A sweet survival defense roguelite where sugar is life and gummy bears are out for revenge.

Key Features

  • Roguelite Progression

    Level up and choose from dozens of power-ups for yourself and your turrets—stack crazy effects and discover powerful synergies.

  • Sweet Combat

    Blast through waves of gummy bears using your Toothpaste Blaster, Gatling Turret, and Rocket Launcher Turret.

  • Base Building & Defense

    Collect sugar cubes, place turrets, and strategically expand your Tooth Base.

  • Enemy Variety

    • Red Gummy: Slow and tanky.

    • Green Gummy: Fast and explosive.

    • Yellow Gummy: Heavy hitter with high HP.

  • Satisfying Loot & Collection

    Watch sugar cubes burst into the air and magnetically zip to you in a juicy collection effect.

  • Endless Replayability

    Every run is different thanks to random upgrades, wave scaling, and stacking modifiers that change how you play.

Themes

  • Satisfying power progression

  • Defend and survive under pressure

  • Sweet but chaotic candy warfare

  • Risk-reward decision making with roguelite upgrades

Made for Fun & Chaos

Candy Land was developed in Unity as a fast-paced roguelite prototype blending base defense, arena shooting, and over-the-top power scaling.
